description: Library V1: Book Store - XML-based book management system running on Flask. Primary application interface for uploading and managing books using XML format. Accessible via HTTP on port 5000.
notes: The application accepts XML input and appears to echo it back (potential XXE vulnerability endpoint). HTTP methods allowed on /addbook are GET, HEAD, POST, OPTIONS. Root path only allows GET, HEAD, OPTIONS. No authentication required. The application provides XML example with sensitive contact information in the template.
